The '''Outer Rim Alliance''' was an association of refugees in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] formed due to the inability of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to defend the Outer Rim from the threat of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==History==
The Outer Rim Alliance was created following the [[Battle of Shramar]] highlighted the inability of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to defend distant Outer Rim worlds from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. It was formed by escapees from the battle who had gathered in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Refugees from [[Artorias]] under [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nina Galfridian]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kaye Galfridian]], and [[Arbeloa]].<ref name="Invasions: Revelations">[[Invasion: Revelations 5|''Invasion: Revelations'' 5]]</ref> joined New Republic forces from [[Dibrook]] and the surrounding region, under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bylsma]].<ref name="Invasions: Revelations" /> as well as some [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces from [[Shramar]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bristow]],<ref name="Invasions: Revelations" /> and various [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and other private vessels.<ref name="Invasions: Revelations" />

The [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Cianba]] also journeyed with the Alliance.<ref name="Invasions: Revelations" />
